description:
## What's new

- **Wrapped tab.** New Lunara Wrapped tab showing your weekly, monthly and yearly listening recaps with beautiful stats cards.
- **Wrapped share.** Share your Wrapped recap as an Instagram-style story image to any app.
- **Changelog.** In-app changelog now shows what changed in each release.
- **Fixes.** Resolved Kotlin compilation errors in the Library screen and wired real playback-history Wrapped statistics.

Enjoy your music recap!

## What's new

- **Compilation fixes.** Resolved Kotlin compilation errors in the Library screen (Wrapped stats, modifier weight, syntax).
- **Wrapped stats.** Wrapped popup now computes real weekly, monthly and yearly play counts from your playback history.
- **Stability.** Various crash fixes and UI stability improvements.

## What's new

Initial release of Lunara.

- **Music playback.** Play, pause, skip and seek with background playback, notification controls and lock screen controls.
- **Library management.** Browse by songs, albums, artists and playlists, create custom playlists, and search your collection.
- **Audio quality.** Built-in equalizer with presets, adjustable playback speed, and a sleep timer.
- **Interface.** Clean modern design with light and dark theme support.
